candidate.document_title: NASA Manufacturing and Test Requirements for Normally Closed Pyrovalves for Hazardous Flight Systems Applications

requirements.source_excerpt: All valves shall be proof tested to a minimum pneumatic proof pressure at 1.5xMEOP.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Every valve requires pneumatic proof testing at or above 1.5 times MEOP.

requirements.source_excerpt: demonstrated on every unit during assembly, with pressure applied individually to each line
requirements.engineering_meaning: The proof-pressure capability must be demonstrated for every unit during assembly, pressurizing each line individually and the housing separately through the actuation ram chamber while lines are vented.
normalized_constraints: For every unit during assembly: apply pressure individually to each line.
For every unit during assembly: apply pressure separately to the valve housing through the actuation ram chamber while the lines are vented.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies to every unit during assembly.

requirements.source_excerpt: The test shall be performed on all parent metal shear-section and all parts of the valve exposed
requirements.engineering_meaning: The applicable proof/leak test must cover every parent-metal shear-section and every valve part exposed to pressure after actuation.
normalized_constraints: Test all valve parts exposed to pressure after valve actuation.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Covers all parent-metal shear-sections and all post-actuation pressure-exposed valve parts.

requirements.source_excerpt: All welds shall be leak tested either during assembly or acceptance testing.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Each weld must undergo leak testing, performed during assembly or during acceptance testing.
normalized_constraints: For all welds: leak_test performed during assembly OR acceptance testing.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies to all welds; either listed test stage is permitted.

requirements.source_excerpt: Either non-destructive acceptance testing shall be accomplished or the risk of defects be mitigated through process control.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Defect risk must be addressed through either non-destructive acceptance testing or process control.
normalized_constraints: Perform non-destructive acceptance testing OR mitigate defect risk through process control.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: One of the two stated alternatives is required.

requirements.source_excerpt: If process control is used, approval shall be obtained from the NASA Fracture Control Board
requirements.engineering_meaning: Where process control is selected, NASA Fracture Control Board approval is required for spacecraft whose programmatic requirements require it.
normalized_constraints: IF process_control is used AND programmatic requirements require it for the spacecraft, THEN obtain NASA Fracture Control Board approval.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Conditional on use of process control and spacecraft programmatic requirements.

requirements.source_excerpt: growth of the maximum credible crack size shall be demonstrated to the fracture control authority to be non-credible
requirements.engineering_meaning: If fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used for NASA-STD-5019 compliance, the fracture-control authority must receive a demonstration that growth of the maximum credible crack is non-credible, using knowledge of applicable quality-control and manufacturing techniques.
normalized_constraints: IF fracture mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, THEN demonstrate to the fracture control authority that maximum credible crack growth is non-credible.
Base the demonstration on knowledge of quality-control and manufacturing techniques used for the valve.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies only when fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used to verify compliance.

requirements.source_excerpt: the NC parent metal valve shall be capable of surviving four times the design operational life.
requirements.engineering_meaning: The valve must be capable of survival for four times its design operational life, regardless of the technical method used to establish the capability.
normalized_constraints: Valve survival capability >= 4 × design operational life.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies regardless of how the capability is technically established.

requirements.source_excerpt: verified by proof testing at 1.5xMEOP, independently applied to each parent metal shear-section
requirements.engineering_meaning: A valve intended to provide two separate, independent pre-actuation parent-metal barriers must demonstrate that capability by specified independent and external proof-test applications, without permanent deformation or leakage during LAT.
normalized_constraints: IF the valve design provides two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation, THEN proof test each parent-metal shear-section independently at 1.5 × MEOP.
Then apply the proof test externally to the shear-section when welded in the housing.
During LAT, permanent deformation = none AND leakage = none.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies only to designs intended to provide two separate and independent parent-metal flow barriers before actuation.

requirements.source_excerpt: The minimum hold time for each burst pressure test shall be 5 min.
requirements.engineering_meaning: Each burst-pressure test must maintain its test condition for at least five minutes.
normalized_constraints: For each burst-pressure test: hold_time >= 5 min.

requirements.source_excerpt: minimum design burst pressure of 2.5xMEOP for lines with diameters ≥3.8 cm
requirements.engineering_meaning: The minimum design burst-pressure multiplier depends on line diameter: 2.5 times MEOP for lines at least 3.8 cm (1.5 in) in diameter, and 4.0 times MEOP for smaller lines.
normalized_constraints: IF line_diameter >= 3.8 cm (>= 1.5 in), THEN minimum_design_burst_pressure >= 2.5 × MEOP.
IF line_diameter < 3.8 cm (< 1.5 in), THEN minimum_design_burst_pressure >= 4.0 × MEOP.
requirements.coverage_or_condition: Applies to all NC parent-metal valves; threshold selection is conditional on line diameter.

requirements.source_excerpt: This capability shall be demonstrated on at least one NC parent metal valve from each lot.
requirements.engineering_meaning: The applicable design burst-pressure capability must be demonstrated using at least one NC parent-metal valve from every manufacturing lot.
